title: fix some lemmas in ghost_tree, update fvt11
base_method: All three approved issues share problem snapshot 58c6aac. Use its immutable first parent 40a0a11f as the comparison base, yielding a reliable non-empty four-path historical comparison. The labeled ghost_tree and three FVT11 caller files are unchanged in this comparison and are exported as fixed additional context, not changed_paths.

verification.source_export: Regenerate the full-index binary diff for 40a0a11f0add408cab7eada88ea266175266b159..58c6aac4274bf63b0fc5179d54a9dec5dc013892 and byte-check every manifest entry against fixed Git blobs; four repair/caller-context paths are exported as additional_context_paths.
verification.tool_result: Two independent reviewers approved three semantic roots at common problem snapshot 58c6aac: incorrect root-inclusive trace values/length, an underconstrained admitted seek_trace_next theorem, and false subtree-removal theorems that assume child-value uniqueness. Library repair ab845472 fixes or removes the APIs; 9d8e1b1 adapts FVT11 callers. Historical Verus was not executed; roots 1 and 3 have direct finite counterexamples and root 2 has explicit missing expression domains.
